best_idea: Keep one input stack where only the top panel reads keys, and remember each panel's last control so closing a panel returns focus to where the player left it.
decision_why: Take the stack and the per-panel focus memory; name the bottom insert for what it does, remember focus on every removal, and use one gate (the stack) rather than the donor's two (the unused layer rule is dead code).
acceptance: With the fight HUD open, a menu pushed over it takes the arrow keys and the fight ignores them; closing the menu returns the keys to the fight and puts focus back on the control the player last used (a client test pushes, moves focus, pops and asserts focus restored, with no key handled on the push frame).
